paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Orlah, chapter 3, halakhah 2: Abba bar Yirmeyah [and] Kahana bar Yirmeyah, in Shmuel’s name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The matching line אבא בר ירמיה כהנא בר ירמיה בשם שמואל appears in the Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 3:3. Hyman’s supplied locator 3:2 is retained; the comparison does not establish the history of the differing divisions.

The whole Guggenheimer Orlah 3:3 paragraph has Abba bar Yirmeyah and Kahana bar Yirmeyah in Shmuel’s name. The bracketed conjunction renders the supplied juxtaposition without merging the people or fathers. Hyman’s 3:2 remains distinct from the digital location; the current note remains verbatim, without inventing a division history.
